entries.text: make heavy-sentinel runs a per-user watcher that stops the largest python, java or database-server process in any BenchBox checkout or worktree once it passes BENCHBOX_HEAVY_MEMORY_BUDGET_GIB (or memory pressure is elevated while they together exceed it), even when it was not started through the host lock; make heavy-sentinel-install and heavy-sentinel-uninstall manage a per-user LaunchAgent, logs go to ~/.benchbox/sentinel.log, BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=warn reports only, make heavy-status shows whether the sentinel is running, and both warn (without signalling) when 16 or more git processes, or a quarter of RAM in git footprint, sit in BenchBox checkouts.
